searchText: This isn't evidence that they are bad, just that they are never tried. Considering that historically all currencies are centrally minted and minting money is incredibly profitable for the minter, it isn't surprising that it is generally not attempted. Inflationary/deflationary monetary supply is what I think most people here mean when they talk about those terms. Not the price. Great! That’s the way I see it too 😊 Another analysis of 1559's impact on mining profitability: https://github.com/louisoutin/eip1559_analysis going to cross-post in <#798586271445680129>, but wanted to surface here given the volume of the other channel
